latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI App Download.

- Instantly edit and export videos with AI—no manual sliders or desktop software needed.
- Upload raw clips (up to 500MB), describe desired edits (e.g., trim pauses, add music), and receive 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more for input files.
- Automated session setup, authentication, and credits handling with a seamless cloud-based workflow.
- Easy error handling and status updates for a user-friendly experience.
